name: Clipboard Leak & Snooping Detector
desc: Audit, inspect, and evaluate clipboard snooping events, mime-type exposures, and unauthorized reading vectors locally in your browser. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: EXIF & Geolocation Metadata Stripper
desc: Purge embedded GPS coordinates, camera serial numbers, timestamps, lens profiles, and device telemetry locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: GPC & DNT Signal Inspector
desc: Audit Global Privacy Control (GPC) and Do Not Track (DNT) browser signals directly in your client runtime. Zero telemetry, zero logging.

name: Media Container Tag Inspector
desc: Inspect, extract, and evaluate metadata headers, atom structures, and container tags inside MP4, MKV, MP3, and media binaries locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Onion Address & Hidden Service Validator
desc: Validate, parse, and verify Tor v2 and v3 onion addresses locally in your browser. Inspect Base32 encodings, checksums, and service descriptors without network leaks.

name: PDF Metadata Redactor & Sanitizer
desc: Inspect, extract, and permanently strip hidden PDF metadata (Author, Producer, Software, Creation Date, XMP XML) directly in local browser memory. 100% private.

name: Canvas Steganography Tool
desc: Encode and extract hidden textual payloads within image pixel Least Significant Bits (LSB) entirely in browser memory. Zero network egress.

name: Browser Storage Cleaner & Persistence Auditor
desc: Inspect, enumerate, and purge browser storage vectors locally in your browser memory. Audit LocalStorage, SessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache API, and Web SQL with zero telemetry.

name: URL Tracking Parameter Stripper & Privacy Cleaner
desc: Strip marketing trackers, telemetry tokens, click IDs (fbclid, gclid, utm_*), and referral parameters locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
